guideline: Evaluation on the seen and unseen splits with human-annotated goals reveals that language models fine-tuned with action modeling on expert demonstrations and successful trajectories are capable of solving a large proportion of goals formulated in open-ended natural language.

changes_made.explanation: The paper mentions human-annotated goals but does not conduct human evaluation of model outputs. The human annotations were used to create test goals, not to evaluate model performance.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on action generation in text-based environments (ALFWorld) using fine-tuned language models. Evaluation is primarily through automatic success rate metrics. While human annotations were used to create test goals, no human evaluation of model outputs was conducted. The extraction was generally accurate with minor normalization needed.
